messages:
sam: Quick FYI - ran into a weird SDK startup thing on Cloudflare Workers while testing sampleapp-edge. Authorization header appears twice on a single request. Repro pretty small. Anyone hit this?

mira: yes saw this locally earlier. Looks like bundler ended up including both ESM + CJS chunks because of our conditional exports, and both modules ran top-level init that attaches auth.

kevin: double header or double requests? can you paste the outgoing header debug?

sam: double header on the same POST. deploy-bot logged:
[deploy-bot] outgoing POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate headers: Authorization: Bearer abc123, Authorization: Bearer abc123, Content-Type: application/json

mira: reproduced with wrangler + esbuild. package.json had exports: {"./runtime": {"import": "./dist/runtime.mjs","require":"./dist/runtime.cjs"}} and the worker did import { RedwoodClient } from './runtime' — esbuild sometimes bundles both.

angel: right. when both runtime.mjs and runtime.cjs are inlined we end up running init code twice. Our auth middleware attaches header lazily but we also do a top-level attach in the CJS path for older environments. Combination = duplicate.

kevin: immediate mitigation: make top-level init idempotent and stop attaching headers as a side-effect. prefer request-time injection.

mira: I added a small guard in my local patch: `if (globalThis.__redwood_init_done) return; globalThis.__redwood_init_done = true;` and moved header attach into the request pipeline. Fixes the duplicate header.

sam: thanks. any docs we should update for workers?

angel: add a devex note: avoid ambiguous conditional exports for worker bundles. Better: provide a single explicit worker-target ESM build and show exact import path in sampleapp-edge README (e.g., import { RedwoodClient } from './dist/runtime.mjs').

mira: also a TS tip - editors pick the wrong .d.ts with conditional exports. we should add an explicit `types` target in exports to make IDEs use the ESM types.

kevin: CI idea: add a Miniflare smoke test that builds sampleapp-edge, runs it, and asserts outgoing requests have at most one Authorization header. run on PRs touching SDK or sampleapp-edge.

ci-bot: queued job: sampleapp-edge/miniflare-smoke (optional).

sam: for immediate unblock can folks patch sampleapp-edge to import the built mjs directly and pin wrangler config to use esbuild target es2020? that reduced bundling surprises for me.

angel: yes. I'll add a tiny sample worker (dist/worker.mjs) and wrangler.toml snippet in the repo with explicit build steps. Also will propose an SDK shim that protects against double-init as a short-term safety net.

kevin: long-term we should revisit package exports layout so bundlers pick the right chunk for workers. + docs page on "SDK in Edge Runtimes": common bundlers quirks, minimal wrangler example, and workaround recipes.

mira: opening PR with the init-guard + README changes + example worker import. Tagging @kevin for review. Will follow up with CI smoke test PR.

sam: awesome, thanks all. saved me a few hours. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: [log] build artifacts: sampleapp-edge/dist/runtime.mjs, sampleapp-edge/dist/runtime.cjs

kevin: thanks @mira and @angel. once merged I'll ping the SDK changelog and put a short note in the CF Workers onboarding guide.

mira: will do.
